verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own homepage states you can 'take part in secure workflows by signing commits,' which confirms the product has a first-party commit-signing capability. That is the only evidence: the SSH key and identity docs describe keys for authentication, not signing. missing for 10: which key types are supported for signing (GPG vs SSH), how a signing key is set up and attached, confirmation that signatures verify on hosting providers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
